invariants.objective: Minimize WHestBench private-suite adjusted MSE for the fixed d=256,L=32 task with a legal universal estimator and zero resource failures.
invariants.score_formula: MSE * max(0.1, (billed_FLOPs + 1e11 * residual_seconds) / 2.72e11) under installed WHestBench 0.14.0 and FlopScope 0.10.0.
invariants.legality_boundary: All MLP-dependent arithmetic is instrumented; no public lookup, private-target reconstruction, counter mutation, hidden native arithmetic, API dependency, or evaluator exploit. Offline fitting is whole-MLP grouped and inference features are weight-derived.
invariants.resource_ceiling: Hard C <= 272000000000; promotion safety gate Cmax < 258400000000 and zero failures.
invariants.development_split: Public indices 0..599 for mechanism development; current generation has used only 0..99 for new premises.
invariants.holdout_split: Indices 600..799 locked for one post-freeze read; indices 800..999 prohibited for this generation; private suite untouched.
invariants.champion_score: official public0..99 raw 3.089512726e-7, adjusted 2.257079776e-7, mean C 202.281790B, max C 250.488783B, failures 0/100
invariants.randomization: setup seed 0; candidate uses 126 seeded Haar frames and antipodal/folded propagation

candidates.mechanism: Reduce the recursive-frame parent to 32,256 base directions so activation-dependent tail cost stays below the failure cliff.
candidates.bias_class: Randomized unbiased spherical sampling with exact algebraic folds and frozen known-mean control terms.
candidates.prediction: Slightly worse raw variance but better adjusted score and zero budget failures.
candidates.kill_condition: Any candidate failure, Cmax >=258.4B, or paired official100 bootstrap CI reaching parity.
candidates.sensitivity: On 95 both-success networks adjusted score improved 6.44% while raw MSE worsened 14.71%; official CI includes five parent failure penalties.

candidates.mechanism: Predict deterministic full-covariance closure residual from 70 symmetry-quotiented Hermite, gauge-edge, cancellation, and dyadic-depth features.
candidates.prediction: Whole-MLP OOF residual R2 above 0.965 at under 0.22B incremental inference cost.
candidates.kill_condition: OOF R2 <=0.965, bootstrap lower <=0.94, symmetry failure, or worst network ratio >2.
candidates.result: OOF R2 0.662672 [0.622890,0.697078]; scale-only 0.648801; all symmetries passed.

candidates.mechanism: Compress the connected fourth-cumulant vertex to pair rank 5 and transport it through depth.
candidates.prediction: At most 30% k4 error with stable downstream correction signs for a bare cost below 50B.
candidates.kill_condition: Raw k4 error >30%, unstable downstream sign/cosine, or projected cost >50B.
candidates.result: Optimal ceiling downstream cosine -1.000 and error 25.88x; CountSketch mean raw error 49.83%.

candidates.mechanism: Use a maximal real MUB/Kerdock spherical design to annihilate low-degree harmonics.
candidates.prediction: Lower raw variance per evaluation than random frames.
candidates.kill_condition: Official combined cost exceeds budget safety or adjusted score loses.
candidates.result: Exact construction passed; structured gate survival caused nonlinear cost excess and failures.

candidates.mechanism: Propagate exact full covariance and reclose every ReLU layer as Gaussian.
candidates.prediction: Cheap weight-analytic estimate below the sampling frontier.
candidates.kill_condition: Raw premise MSE above 1.4e-6 or no stable sampler-control correlation.
candidates.result: Raw 5.428e-5; numerically exact implementation but repeated Gaussian reclosure dominates bias.

candidates.mechanism: Resum finite-width corrections through cavity, Dyson, TAP, or Onsager feedback.
candidates.kill_condition: No feed-forward self-reaction or required state exceeds O(Ln3).
candidates.result: Feed-forward DAG has zero Onsager self-reaction; generic connected vertex is O(n4)/O(n5).

candidates.mechanism: Predict a network-specific analytic/sampler blend coefficient from weights.
candidates.prediction: Recover part of the 22.15% per-network oracle blend gain.
candidates.result: ICC 0.129 and all six cross-seed oracle-transfer tests failed.

candidates.mechanism: Transport a factorized third cumulant with a fixed recent-layer horizon H, preserving coordinatewise sign while bounding rank and cost.
candidates.bias_class: Biased finite-memory BASE K=3 cumulant closure.
candidates.prediction: One horizon in H={2,4,8,12,16} is finite, safe, and materially improves analytic raw MSE with plausible adjusted-score headroom.
candidates.kill_condition: Small-shape algebra mismatch, nonfinite output, Cmax unsafe, no raw improvement, or no plausible route to 2.257e-7 adjusted.
candidates.result: Parity passed to 5.19e-15 and all horizons were safe, but best H2 adjusted score 1.3162e-4 was 583.1x worse than champion; oracle scalar damping still cannot win at the 0.1 multiplier floor.

candidates.mechanism: Contract layerwise connected cumulant defects with downstream observable adjoints instead of materializing full k3/k4 tensors.
candidates.bias_class: Biased deterministic first-Born Hermite defect correction on a frozen Gaussian background.
candidates.prediction: Exact small-n contraction factors into stable O(Ln3) matrix/Hadamard operations for all outputs.
candidates.kill_condition: Requires generic n4 state, loses correction sign, duplicates a killed truncation, or exceeds budget before lower-order work.
candidates.result: Terminal k3/k4 projections passed exact tests and cost 3.111B, but improved public0..4 fullcov MSE only 2.12%; the complete covariance adjoint becomes generic full rank after one ReLU pullback and requires O(Ln4) work. Preserve the terminal operator; hard-kill promotion.

candidates.mechanism: Condition each Gaussian closure layer on one or two weight-identified leading covariance factors, rectify diagonal residuals analytically, and recompress the finite mixture after each layer.
candidates.prediction: A fixed q,r closure preserves coordinatewise non-Gaussian dependence missed by fullcov while remaining permutation/gauge invariant and below O(Ln3 q).
candidates.kill_condition: Collapses to the killed scalar scale mixture, is not identified equivariantly, mixture growth/recompression exceeds budget, or exact small-n premise shows no material gain over fullcov.
candidates.result: q=3,r=2 passed the original small-width premise but failed the adversarial width law: 0/8 wins at n=64 with ratios 2.928 and 1.596. Top-two trace capture collapses from 88.4% at n=4 to 3.02% at n=256. Kill this fixed-r tensor-quadrature implementation; preserve forward weight-defined components, analytic diagonal rectification, recompression, and symmetry.

candidates.mechanism: Increase only the screened latent factor rank from r=2 to r=3 while freezing q=3, tensor quadrature, recompression, and references.
candidates.prediction: Rank three improves the frozen aggregate ratio below 0.035 while preserving invariance and conservative target arithmetic below 40B.
candidates.kill_condition: Aggregate ratio at least 0.035, broken invariance, or conservative arithmetic at least 40B.
candidates.result: The exact child scored ratio 0.0602767, 27.22% worse than r=2 and above the 0.035 gate; invariance and 33.075B conservative arithmetic passed. Kill the r=3 leaf; extra tensor resolution is aliased by unchanged three-component compression and still cannot fix width-scaled trace capture.

candidates.mechanism: Replace q^r tensor Gauss-Hermite nodes with signed spherical-radial nodes over an adaptive leading subspace capturing a fixed covariance-trace fraction.
candidates.prediction: O(r) signed nodes preserve a nonvanishing trace fraction without exponential child growth and beat corrected fullcov at n=64.
candidates.kill_condition: n=64 aggregate ratio above 0.8, fewer than 6/8 wins, broken scale/permutation invariance, or conservative target arithmetic at least 80B.

candidates.mechanism: Replace selected-factor tensor quadrature with a full-covariance 2n-point spherical-radial rule built from the symmetric PSD square root.
candidates.prediction: Exact covariance matching with O(n) children removes rank collapse while retaining deterministic q=3 recompression and permutation equivariance.
candidates.kill_condition: n=64 aggregate ratio above 0.8, fewer than 6/8 wins, broken scale/permutation invariance, or conservative target arithmetic at least 80B.
